text: Only the exclusive (separate) is all-pervading; only the exclusive alone is present. As the earth is divided from other things because of its odor (its quality of being odorous), so it is not divided from other things that lack that odor. In the same way, water is distinct, but not in the same way as fire. Hence, “that is not there.” Here, there is no example (analogy) that says “what is odorous is different from the other,” because the earth alone is the sole subject of the statement. (Verse 44)
